messages:
noah: Postmortem follow-up: we tracked repeated kv evictions leading to OOM on node-7. Putting together owners for remediation.
zara: i'll own fragmentation profiling and GC trace correlation. plan: run `massif` + heaptrack on a low-traffic canary for 6h and correlate with eviction logs. ETA next Tue.
ops-bot: Canary deployment started: kv-frag-probe -> canary-3 (build 5902). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5902
noah: short-term mitigation idea: temporary shard-level hardlimit for allocations from rerank flow; need infra change though.
sre-oncall: add to runbook: if OOM repeat within 12h, set `RERANK_MAX_ALLOCS=50` env for rerank pods and scale readers x2.
kevin: i'll handle the regression test harness to replay the heavy rerank traffic in staging. plan to run 10 replay jobs over 24h and produce median RSS and residency metrics. ETA Thu EOD.
zara: success criteria: 25% reduction in 95p residency and no OOMs in staging replay. will update RINF-1299 with artifacts.
noah: owners: zara=profiling (Tue), kevin=replay harness (Thu), sre-oncall=runbook + short term env guard, noah=tracking + stakeholder update. sync Fri 9am to review.
kevin: adding automated diff against baseline for `malloc` sites and `jemalloc` retained arenas. will post scripts in the ticket.
sre-oncall: if we see fragmentation spikes, consider adding a fragment scavenger run every hour. Need ops approval for added CPU.
noah: sounds good. thanks all.
